why: A one-line Supply Bills report of 1983, 'Resolved,' over the motion text and '[Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam]', was one row credited to the mover; a Resolved line records the decision, so it and the motion text it carries are one procedural row with no speaker.
title: SUPPLY AND SUPPLEMENTARY SUPPLY BILLS

Section Name:MOTIONS
Title:SUPPLY AND SUPPLEMENTARY SUPPLY BILLS
MPs Speaking:Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam (Minister for Trade and Industry);


Column: 825

SUPPLY AND SUPPLEMENTARY SUPPLY BILLS
(Business Motion)

2.44 p.m.

    Resolved,

    That, notwithstanding the Standing Orders, the second and third readings of the Supply Bill for the financial year 1st April, 1983 to 31st

Column: 826

March, 1984 and the Supplementary Supply Bill for the financial year 1st April, 1982 to 31st March, 1983 may be proceeded with immediately on the conclusion of the proceedings on the Budget for the financial year 1st April, 1983 to 31st March, 1984. - [Dr Tony Tan Keng Yam].
